raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 12
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer introduced an incorrect birthdate for Charles Saunders by surfacing a Wikipedia snippet that listed him as born in 1946, without disambiguating or verifying that this was the same Charles Saunders who directed Love in Pawn (1953). The correct director, Charles Joel Saunders, was born on 1904-04-08. Relying on the 1946 date would wrongly suggest Love in Pawn’s director was born later than Fernando Fernán Gómez (1921-08-28), leading to the incorrect conclusion.
